The quote prices 1,310 WEEKDAYS per security while the vendor returns 1,260 TRADING days, so `drawn < quoted` will leave the request open after full coverage and the 2026-10-18 fire would be the first zero-cell no-op. It affects no t27 criterion and the remedy is a round decision, not a mid-round edit; nothing was weakened here.

MDPF_DEMQUE-Z-S2: a mid-draw re-quote reads finish_date 2026-10-18 against the frozen 2026-10-17, because quote() prices the full request forward from the as-of date and never subtracts drawn cells. The frozen quote stays the authority and no criterion reads a finish date; filed because two dates side by side is a false-alarm generator.
